answers.description: I want to build a mobile app in flutter that is an app I can use to track books I want to read, am readying, and have read (and notes / ratings). Think of goodreads meets evernote, but a more modern and minimalist application that's high-quality and engaging. I also want it to be easy to get books I want via Libby app (library) or buy them (ideally from an indie store but from amazon or someone bigger if needed). Can you help me map out a plan? I will start on iOS but may push to iOS and Android. I also want a website for this app, but want to start with the mobile app itself
